_comment: **One position per chunk, and no modifier that moves it.** A formation may be wider than a chunk,
so it cannot be built outwards from a position vanilla hands it -- it runs once per chunk and lays
the part of every formation that crosses this one. Where they sit is the `scatter` in the
`count 1` rather than an empty list: an empty placement is a placed feature vanilla's own feature
sorter does not carry into the list `applyBiomeDecoration` indexes, so decoration looked ours up,
missed, and threw -1 into a list of 107 on every chunk.
